rec.name: How It Works – 3-Step Accordion Cards
rec.status: Built — live (desktop typography tweaks scheduled after go-live)

what.text: A 'How it works' section that explains the process in three numbered steps. It has a small uppercase eyebrow line, a large headline (here 'And this is how Sectionfy works', with the brand name as a green logo), and three side-by-side cards. Each card sits under a 'STEP 1/2/3' label with a green dot and thin horizontal lines on both sides. Each card has a bold title and a plus/minus toggle. Collapsed cards show only the title. Expanded cards show a short descriptive paragraph. The example steps are: Buy a section, Add it in Shopify, Customize.

why.text: Breaking the purchase and onboarding journey into three simple steps lowers perceived effort and complexity. Buyers see that the product is easy to adopt: no developer, little time, little cost. The numbered sequence gives a clear mental path from purchase to result. The expandable cards keep the page scannable and let interested visitors read the detail. This reduces uncertainty ('Can I really do this myself?') before the visitor commits.

how.text: Build a section with an eyebrow text, a heading and three blocks. Each block has a step label, a title and a body text. Render each block as a collapsible card with a plus/minus icon (accordion or disclosure pattern). Use a 3-column grid on desktop and a stacked layout on mobile. Keep the body texts about the same length so expanded cards have equal heights. Per the feedback, make the eyebrow larger, regular-weight and higher-contrast on desktop, and make the step labels a bit larger. Mobile was approved as-is.

items: Heading text (with an optional brand logo or accent-colored word)
Accent color for the step dot (green in the example)
Desktop font sizes for eyebrow and step labels

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields apparent. It needs a dark or neutral theme background and a small piece of JS or a native <details> element for the toggle. The brand logo in the heading is an image or SVG asset.

items: Scroll depth to and past the section
Accordion open/expand click rate per step
Conversion rate or add-to-cart rate for visitors who saw the section vs. those who did not

images.caption: Collapsed state on desktop: eyebrow, headline with brand logo, three STEP labels and three cards with a plus icon. The red annotations are feedback marks (eyebrow hard to read, steps could be bigger).
Expanded state: all three cards open with a minus icon and a descriptive paragraph. Card heights are aligned after the texts were evened out.
